start: Read actual branch refs; compare last observed commit to current
Read only changed scientific dependencies, owner contracts and relevant instructions
Pin immutable commit/path/blob/hash before deriving or running; skip unchanged suites
before_publication: If supplier advanced, compare changed paths and reconcile actual overlap; base new tree on current head, never reset or force
If consumer dependency changed, do not mark older binding current; inspect changed dependency once before final publication
after_publication: Confirm branch ref and tree/blob identity against intended changed files
Record input pins separately from resulting publication commit
End validation once selected identity tier closes; no automatic re-download
no_change_rule: No new atomic calculation or wrapper merely because the user asks to continue; report waiting state when no dependency trigger changed
source_policy: No auto source ranking, clamp, null-to-zero, RCT opt-in or closure choice
